verdict.rationale: Hatchet is a workflow orchestration engine, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back workflows is a fair axis. However, the evidence never mentions workflow versioning, version history, diff/review, or rollback. The available items cover local hot-reload, environment profiles, a TUI for observability, and enterprise audit logs, none of which shows automations can be versioned or reverted. Workflows being defined in SDK code may imply git-based versioning, but that is not evidenced as a product capability.
